Concept cutaway battery PIR lamp with four clear modules: BATTERY at lower rear, CONTROLLER board center, PIR sensor behind circular lower front lens, LED board behind upper diffuser. Simple wires battery to controller, controller to LED, sensor signal to controller. Title ELECTRONICS CONCEPT. No mains circuitry, no authentic teardown claim. Reference supplies identity only. Preserve coherent structure and correct specified labels. Original instruction /electronics: Reveal the main electronic modules and wiring.

source.prompt: Square clean studio product photograph of a generic battery-powered indoor PIR motion sensor wall light. Compact rounded rectangular warm-white plastic body, upper wide frosted rectangular LED diffuser, small circular white faceted Fresnel motion sensor lens centered beneath diffuser, discreet side sliding switch. Rear wall bracket visible beside light. No mains cable, no solar panel, no text, no brand. Three-quarter view on pale gray background. Plausible everyday design.
